lines.text: Joshua gathers all the tribes of Israel at Shechem and summons the elders, leaders, judges, and officers.
The LORD sends Moses and Aaron, and at the Red Sea He puts darkness between Israel and the Egyptians.
Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, sends for Balaam son of Beor to curse Israel, but Balaam blesses them.
Joshua tells the people they cannot serve the LORD, a holy God, yet they say they will, and he calls them witnesses.
Joshua son of Nun dies at the age of 120 and is buried at Timnath-serah in Ephraim.
